mapper.select: SELECT d.*, e1.emp_name as dept_manager_name, e1.emp_code as dept_manager_code, e2.emp_name as nurse_manager_name, e2.emp_code as nurse_manager_code, e3.emp_name as vice_president_name, e3.emp_code as vice_president_code FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_emp e1 ON d.dept_manager_id = e1.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_emp e2 ON d.nurse_manager_id = e2.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_emp e3 ON d.vice_president_id = e3.emp_id WHERE d.dept_id = #{deptId}

SELECT d.*, e1.emp_name as dept_manager_name, e1.emp_code as dept_manager_code, e2.emp_name as nurse_manager_name, e2.emp_code as nurse_manager_code, e3.emp_name as vice_president_name, e3.emp_code as vice_president_code FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_emp e1 ON d.dept_manager_id = e1.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_emp e2 ON d.nurse_manager_id = e2.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_emp e3 ON d.vice_president_id = e3.emp_id WHERE d.dept_code = #{deptCode} AND d.is_stop = 0

SELECT d.*, e1.emp_name as dept_manager_name, e1.emp_code as dept_manager_code, e2.emp_name as nurse_manager_name, e2.emp_code as nurse_manager_code, e3.emp_name as vice_president_name, e3.emp_code as vice_president_code FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_emp e1 ON d.dept_manager_id = e1.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_emp e2 ON d.nurse_manager_id = e2.emp_id LEFT JOIN sys_emp e3 ON d.vice_president_id = e3.emp_id WHERE 1=1
AND (d.is_stop = #{isStop} OR (d.is_stop IS NULL AND #{isStop} = 0))
AND (d.is_stop = 0 OR d.is_stop IS NULL)
ORDER BY d.dept_code ASC
SELECT * FROM sys_dept WHERE super_dept_code = #{superDeptCode} AND is_stop = 0 ORDER BY dept_code ASC
